items.title: Ricard Alexis Interview, 1959-01-16
items.q: And we went to school under Professor Brown in Basin, Lewis.

ctx.x: They lived on Main Street in Basin, Lewis, back Main Street. And we went to school under Professor Brown in Basin, Lewis. Were they Mexican or Spanish or Filipino? No, they were. They looked like they had Indian in them or something. They were. They were. They weren't even Creole. I never heard them talk Creole or nothing like that. They had beautiful black hair. Guys looking big eyes. And they all looked like a nation or something, but they weren't supposed to be.
Did you ever hear young Lorenzo or any of them, his father said they came from Mexico or were ever in Mexico?
